desc:
Drive head-on into traffic on a narrow sky road. Make it to the other side, or get smashed off into the ocean!

Every crossing upgrades you to a bigger, crazier vehicle. How far can you get?

- 5-minute rounds: most crossings wins the podium
- Ram rivals off the edge for knockout cash
- Unlock skills to boost, shove and survive
- 12 maps with tubes, ramps and narrow bridges
- Open crates for skins and upgrade your vehicles

Like and favorite for new vehicles and maps! 🚗💥
